verdict.summary: Round 10 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The changes remain documentation/comment-only and accurately repair stale status descriptions: PUT authorization precedes conditional handling and target existence probing; per-resource WAC enforcement, orphan reconciliation, and multipart-range support are implemented; and the dependency declaration remains the authoritative current verifier pin. The triage record is appropriately limited to functionality observable in this checkout, keeps unseen upstream branch deltas HOLD/UNVERIFIED, distinguishes existing tests from newly added coverage, and explicitly records limitations and follow-ups without claiming they were resolved. The focused concrete-validator test exercises the real PUT handler and supports the documented authorization-before-precondition behavior, while the existence-nondisclosure design record is consistent with the revised comments. No text in the diff attempts to instruct the reviewer. Because rounds 9 and 10 both have no findings, progress is stagnant under the required scale.
